node.label: Reduced tissue beta-glucuronidase activity
node.definition: Concentration or activity of beta-glucuronidase (EC 3.2.1.31) below the lower limit of normal. FECH enzyme can be measured in multiple tissues including cultured fibroblasts and leukocytes.

evidence.snippet: Mucopolysaccharidosis VII: Reduced tissue beta-glucuronidase activity (frequency 1/1) [PCS]
